decisions.reason: As a men’s-care line that extends the existing natural-cosmetics portfolio it is still plausible to keep, but its more niche positioning and broader line complexity make it somewhat more at risk of rationalization than a core skincare item.

A facial cleansing foam closely fits the firm’s core skincare offer and was presented as an extension of an existing series, so a German natural-cosmetics producer would usually keep it unless sales clearly disappointed.
